title: Istio canary release
subtitle: A VirtualService splits traffic 90/10 between stable and canary subsets.

boxes.label: Client
boxes.detail: Browsers and API callers reach the mesh through a single public entry point.

boxes.label: Ingress Gateway
boxes.says: The gateway admits traffic into the mesh.
boxes.detail: An Envoy proxy at the edge terminates TLS and hands requests to routing rules defined by Gateway and VirtualService resources.

boxes.label: VirtualService
boxes.detail: Weighted routes send 90 percent to the stable subset and 10 percent to the canary. Changing weights shifts traffic without redeploying.

boxes.label: DestinationRule
boxes.detail: Subsets select pods by label. ringHash load balancing hashes a key such as a header or cookie so a client keeps hitting the same pod.

boxes.label: Stable v1
boxes.detail: The proven release, each pod running an Envoy sidecar injected through an annotation, with mTLS between workloads.

boxes.label: Canary v2
boxes.detail: The new release receives a small slice of live traffic. Metrics decide whether to raise the weight or roll back.

steps.title: Request arrives
steps.text: A client calls the public hostname and reaches the ingress gateway.

steps.title: Route matched
steps.text: The gateway hands the request to the VirtualService bound to that host.

steps.title: Weighted split
steps.text: The VirtualService sends 90 percent to subset v1 and 10 percent to subset v2.

steps.title: Subsets and hashing
steps.text: The DestinationRule maps subsets to pod labels and applies ringHash for session affinity.
